# Simulator questions and coverage

<!-- Generated by tools/forever_bench/uncertainties.py. Edit uncertainties.json. -->

Current level-60 DPS and tank scenarios, plus conditional spell, item and encounter coverage. This register consolidates the recorded questions; it is not a claim that unlisted game behavior has been verified.

**Latest follow-up (2026-10-28):** October 28 follow-up: a ranged Marksmanship Hunter build (31 or more Marksmanship points with Trueshot Aura, a Cat, Auto Shot from range and no melee) beside MM Weave, and the gear of every DPS build re-selected from the modeled pool on the current engine and confirmed on a second seed. [Latest follow-up report](october-28-follow-up.md).

**Original adjudication baseline:** 2026-09-27, `35cab052456a320358e998c12416687d69cae142`. That original review reconciled questions without changing mechanics or benchmark results. This current register also includes the later implementation and benchmark updates linked above; earlier audits remain historical evidence, not current task status.

**Coverage:** 137/137 original entries reviewed; 87 additional coverage gaps, including later follow-ups.

A working answer is credible enough for an explicitly qualified model, not verified server behavior. Confidence applies to the stated finding, not every effect of that class. An implementation gap is not a request for a game experiment.

## Prioritized follow-up

Each queue is ordered by priority, then stable ID. A question can have partial tests at several stages; these queue counts must not be added together as distinct questions. Accepted-answer corroboration and out-of-scenario work remain inside their records, not in these pending queues.

### Current beta · level 30

An experiment within the current level-30 beta, subject to actual access, learned ranks and prerequisites. Sixteen Legacy Points and Dalaran expand opportunities, not the class talent budget or level-60 access.

- **High · [CORE-001 — Boss attack tables](#core-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Known skill/hit, an equal-level and a +3-level target, recorded facing.
  - Observe / verify: Count white/special/ranged outcomes separately; compare queued and unqueued attacks. This supplies a low-level table, not a level-63 certification.
- **High · [CORE-002 — Energy regeneration and haste](#core-002)**
  - Prerequisites: Two known general-haste totals, identical resource talents, uncapped recovery windows and precise resource timestamps.
  - Observe / verify: Repeat matched recovery cycles from low Energy to below the cap, with no attacks or refunds. Aggregate endpoint uncertainty; a single rounded 1% window is insufficient. Run an attack-speed-only control separately.
- **High · [CORE-004 — Spell GCD versus physical GCD](#core-004)**
  - Prerequisites: Known casting-speed modifier, one magical instant and one physical 1.5-second action; client cooldown timestamps.
  - Observe / verify: Compare GCD duration independently of cast time. Only test the floor when enough haste is actually available; a 1% modifier cannot establish it.
- **High · [DATA-001 — Server downranking penalties](#data-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Two learned ranks of a caster damage spell, controlled SP-only gear changes, fixed target level/resistance and no changing damage talents.
  - Observe / verify: Compare the damage slope per SP at each rank, not their raw hit sizes. Record exact player level and exclude crits; repeat after leveling if possible.
- **High · [DATA-001 — Server downranking penalties](#data-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Level 30 Hunter with Improved Wing Clip and independently accessible lower/higher rank casts, fixed target eligibility.
  - Observe / verify: Estimate landed-hit proc probability by rank/player level, holding talent and target fixed; current highest-rank-only registration cannot answer this.
- **High · [DRU-003 — Form weapon damage and flat imbues](#dru-003)**
  - Prerequisites: Bear and level-20 Cat, matched-stat weapons with substantially different DPS, plus an obtainable flat-damage enchant/imbue.
  - Observe / verify: Compare form attack damage at fixed AP; test the flat effect independently from the weapon swap.
- **High · [DRU-005 — Bear threat multipliers](#dru-005)**
  - Prerequisites: Bear, white attacks/Swipe, precise threat readings, known damage and no Thorns/proc interference.
  - Observe / verify: First determine the form multiplier from ordinary hits, then Swipe's additional threat; include multiple enemies without duplicating totals.
- **High · [DRU-011 — Proc enchants in animal forms](#dru-011)**
  - Prerequisites: Only if an enchanted weapon can actually be supplied in the beta; an obtainable enchant is not established by a low character-level requirement.
  - Observe / verify: Compare isolated caster-form and Cat/Bear attacks with proc timestamps and equipped/form weapon speeds.
- **High · [DRU-012 — Bear outgoing and incoming rage formulas](#dru-012)**
  - Prerequisites: Bear, uncapped rage, no Maul/Enrage/Primal Fury and matched attack speed while damage varies.
  - Observe / verify: Separate ordinary hits, crits and avoided swings. For incoming rage stop autos and vary armor independently from maximum health.
- **High · [DRU-017 — Rake Attack Power scaling](#dru-017)**
  - Prerequisites: A level-30 Cat with Rake; a way to change Attack Power by a known amount (Battle Shout, a Blessing of Might or an AP item).
  - Observe / verify: Rake tick damage (non-crit) with and without the Attack Power change, on a target without bleed modifiers.
- **High · [HUN-001 — Pet owner-stat inheritance](#hun-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Hunter or Warlock pet, one isolated owner-stat change and pet API/damage observations.
  - Observe / verify: Prioritize demon AP/SP/mana and pet update timing; keep owner and external pet buffs distinct. Do not repeat every accepted Hunter coefficient merely because a server script is hidden.
- **High · [HUN-002 — Pet per-hit damage versus speed](#hun-002)**
  - Prerequisites: Two same-family/same-level pets of different speeds and two owner AP totals.
  - Observe / verify: Compare the change in pet damage per hit across the AP delta for each speed; control happiness and training. This separates an AP coefficient from the already observed base-speed difference.
- **High · [PAL-006 — Seal of Fury shield replacement and mana](#pal-006)**
  - Prerequisites: Level 20+ Paladin with Improved Seal of Fury, shield, learned ranks, uncapped mana and known incoming attacker levels.
  - Observe / verify: Measure successive procs, rank switching, partial/full depletion, replacement/expiry and capped attacker-level returns; distinguish generated capacity, absorbed damage and mana.
- **High · [WAR-006 — Flurry amount and charge events](#war-006)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-30 Warrior with 26 Fury points including Death Wish and 1/5 Flurry (for example Fury 25053005040010100, no Arms or Protection points); advanced combat logging.
  - Observe / verify: Auto-attack a mob for three minutes with one weapon, then dual wielding, then with Heroic Strike queued every swing. Count white swings between each Flurry gain and fade, and note whether the buff icon shows 3 charges. About 60 Flurry procs per setup.
- **High · [WAR-008 — Shield attacks and weapon procs](#war-008)**
  - Prerequisites: Shield Bash, shield and an actually obtainable known weapon proc; autos stopped.
  - Observe / verify: Count proc events following isolated Bashes. This is a partial test, not certification of Shield Slam or Windfury.
- **High · [WL-009 — Demonic Knowledge ranked values](#wl-009)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-30 Warlock with 1/3, 2/3 and 3/3 Demonic Knowledge (20 Demonology points first; 26 points are available), fixed owner gear and an active pet.
  - Observe / verify: Measure owner and pet spell power at each rank, despawning and resummoning after each change.
- **Medium · [CORE-009 — Eureka cast and periodic bonuses](#core-009)**
  - Prerequisites: Gnome Mage/Warlock/Priest with a low-rank DoT or channel; exact build and buff-stack timestamps.
  - Observe / verify: Repeat those three cases in game. Do not infer intended behavior from an open bug report or conflate the old mana-discount amount with current values.
- **Medium · [DRU-018 — On-hit effects at the Cat and Bear form attack speed](#dru-018)**
  - Prerequisites: A Cat with a slow (3.0+ speed) weapon carrying a PPM effect, such as Crusader, Fiery Weapon or a chance-on-hit weapon.
  - Observe / verify: Procs per landed white hit and per landed Shred or Claw over a few hundred of each; compare with PPM x 1.0 / 60 and PPM x weapon speed / 60.
- **Medium · [HUN-003 — Pet external buffs and action cadence](#hun-003)**
  - Prerequisites: Only if pet cadence sensitivity proves material; a trained damage ability and a resource trace.
  - Observe / verify: Compare ability use when resource-limited versus resource-capped. Do not mix this with owner inheritance or ordinary spell cooldowns.
- **Medium · [HUN-012 — Savage Strikes article/client version conflict](#hun-012)**
  - Prerequisites: Savage Strikes access and matched talent-on/off attacks at fixed AP, weapon and target.
  - Observe / verify: Separate hit-size changes from crit-frequency changes, and record build/ability IDs.
- **Medium · [HUN-016 — Fire trap Attack Power scaling](#hun-016)**
  - Prerequisites: Hunter with Immolation Trap and two gear sets differing only in melee or only in ranged Attack Power.
  - Observe / verify: Total trap damage per set, about 20 traps each.
- **Medium · [HUN-022 — Auto Shot wind-up and haste](#hun-022)**
  - Prerequisites: A Hunter with Rapid Fire, recording with timestamps.
  - Observe / verify: Time from the start of the wind-up to the shot leaving, with and without Rapid Fire.
- **Medium · [HUN-023 — Off-hand swing after Attack is pressed](#hun-023)**
  - Prerequisites: A dual-wielding Hunter starting melee from range, recording combat log timestamps.
  - Observe / verify: Time from the first main-hand swing to the first off-hand swing.
- **Medium · [PAL-004 — Holy melee partial resistance](#pal-004)**
  - Prerequisites: Holy Strike and seal attacks against targets of known equal and higher levels; fixed damage inputs.
  - Observe / verify: Inspect explicit resisted amounts and damage clusters separately from miss/dodge outcomes. A small sample with no resist is not proof of immunity.
- **Medium · [PAL-010 — Retribution Aura provider scaling](#pal-010)**
  - Prerequisites: Paladin level 16+ or Druid Thorns, distinct caster/recipient, fixed enemy and two caster-SP controls.
  - Observe / verify: Measure base/SP and change caster gear after application; hold recipient gear fixed. Check party/range and damage/threat ownership separately.
- **Medium · [PRI-003 — Inner Focus periodic crit behavior](#pri-003)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-20 Priest with Inner Focus and a DoT in its crit mask.
  - Observe / verify: Compare three arms: no aura, aura activated after the DoT and held, and aura consumed by applying the DoT. Record enough ticks and the exact build; separate live observation from intended design.
- **Medium · [ROG-005 — Hack and Slash hand scope and ICD](#rog-005)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-30 Rogue with 5/5 Hack and Slash (20 Combat points first; 26 points are available) and matched dagger/fist, mace and sword pairs.
  - Observe / verify: Swap MH/OH placement. Compare each hand's crit and armor-sensitive damage, plus a non-weapon spell control; separate a displayed character-sheet bonus from hand-specific outcomes.
- **Medium · [SCEN-005 — General absorb-pool and shielding threat](#scen-005)**
  - Prerequisites: Priest with Power Word: Shield, a cooperating player and a controlled hostile target with threat observation.
  - Observe / verify: Separate threat on shield application, actual absorption and unused expiry; do not attribute incidental healing or damage threat to the shield.
- **Medium · [WAR-010 — Weaponmaster hand-specific armor ignore](#war-010)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-30 Warrior with 1/5 to 5/5 Weaponmaster (20 Arms points first; 26 points are available), comparable mace and non-mace weapons, matched AP and controlled target armor.
  - Observe / verify: Move the mace between hands and measure main-hand damage changes; separate the weapon's own damage change and sword extra attacks. Repeat at 1/5 and 5/5 to confirm rank scaling.
- **Medium · [WAR-029 — Demonic Rune self-damage gives a Warrior rage](#war-029)**
  - Prerequisites: Warrior with a Demonic Rune.
  - Observe / verify: Rage before and after using the Rune out of combat or between pulls.
- **Medium · [WAR-030 — Rage decay before the pull](#war-030)**
  - Prerequisites: A Warrior out of combat with Bloodrage.
  - Observe / verify: Rage every second for 20 s after Bloodrage ends.
- **Medium · [WL-006 — Improved Imp's extra dummy effect](#wl-006)**
  - Prerequisites: A live Imp, ranks 0/1/2/3 of Improved Imp, fixed owner/pet haste and mana.
  - Observe / verify: Record Firebolt cast start/end and the interval before the next cast. Distinguish a shorter cast from removal of the engine's artificial 200-ms recast delay.

### Level-30 beta

Requires reachable level-30 abilities, talents and items. Check training, prerequisite rows and Legacy access; do not invent a new 51-point allocation.

- **High · [DATA-001 — Server downranking penalties](#data-001)**
  - Prerequisites: The same spell/rank and controls at level 30.
  - Observe / verify: Check whether its SP slope changes as the player outlevels the rank. This extends the low-level test, not the level-60 conclusion.
- **High · [DRU-005 — Bear threat multipliers](#dru-005)**
  - Prerequisites: Primal Bite talent, available from 25.
  - Observe / verify: Isolate direct Bite damage and threat with the previously measured form multiplier.
- **High · [WAR-001 — Level-60 outgoing rage normalization](#war-001)**
  - Prerequisites: A known weapon retained across levels and no other rage gains.
  - Observe / verify: Optional extrapolation checkpoint: compare uncapped rage per landed swing before and after leveling. This does not certify level 60.
- **High · [WAR-002 — Off-hand and extra-swing rage](#war-002)**
  - Prerequisites: A sourced extra-attack effect actually available by level 30, and separate MH/OH events.
  - Observe / verify: Isolate extra swings from regular autos and energizes. If no suitable effect is obtainable, defer that subtest rather than substituting ordinary swings.
- **High · [WL-001 — Demonic Brand power source and threat](#wl-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Level 25+ Brand, Imp and a melee demon, controlled owner school power and pet modifiers.
  - Observe / verify: Separate normal pet attacks from Brand events. Vary owner power, record Brand crits and threat, and test a second target without a Brand.
- **Medium · [DRU-008 — Nature's Grace GCD stacking and timing](#dru-008)**
  - Prerequisites: Nature's Grace, cooldown timestamps and controllable Wrath travel distance.
  - Observe / verify: Compare GCDs with the aura and an isolated cast-speed control; compare aura activation with cast completion and projectile impact.
- **Medium · [MAG-004 — Hot Streak interruption and new-charge ordering](#mag-004)**
  - Prerequisites: Level 25+ Hot Streak/Pyro build and cast/impact/aura logs.
  - Observe / verify: Start accelerated Pyro while an earlier Fire projectile is in flight; compare aura stacks at impact and completion. Separately cancel Pyro if interruption support is being evaluated.
- **Medium · [ROG-001 — Mutilate off-hand flat damage and Cold Blood](#rog-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Level 30 Mutilate/Cold Blood allocation, two known daggers, fixed AP and target armor.
  - Observe / verify: Record both child hit/crit outcomes with and without Cold Blood. Swap hand placements and vary AP independently to distinguish flat bonus from weapon contribution.
- **Medium · [ROG-002 — Rogue finisher and poison scaling](#rog-002)**
  - Prerequisites: Deadly Poison access and a controlled AP delta.
  - Observe / verify: Measure one-stack ticks and then five-stack ticks to locate the 0.0045 ratio. Audit finishers in separate AP/CP controls rather than mixing poison proc counts with their damage.

### Beyond level 30 / launch

Requires access beyond the announced level-30 beta or max-level content. Reclassify if later beta access is announced.

- **High · [CORE-001 — Boss attack tables](#core-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-60 characters and level-63 targets on a build without the known glancing defect.
  - Observe / verify: Repeat outcome and crit-suppression counts; compare damage of glances with ordinary hits at fixed AP.
- **High · [CORE-007 — Judgement of Wisdom trigger rules](#core-007)**
  - Prerequisites: A level-38+ Paladin with Seal/Judgement of Wisdom, uncapped mana recipients and isolated event sources.
  - Observe / verify: Count mana returns per white hit, avoided white, special, direct spell, periodic tick and triggered effect. Compare event intervals to distinguish chance from ICD; the level-30 cap does not grant this seal.
- **High · [CORE-011 — Base attributes and class conversions](#core-011)**
  - Prerequisites: Naked level-60 characters with racial/talent bonuses accounted for, plus isolated Agility/Intellect gear deltas.
  - Observe / verify: Record base attributes, health/mana and crit slopes for each class; race pairs isolate racial offsets.
- **High · [DATA-001 — Server downranking penalties](#data-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Level 60 and the actual downranked spells used by the retained APLs.
  - Observe / verify: Repeat the two-SP slope comparison for low and maximum ranks; separate learned-level base growth from the coefficient.
- **High · [DRU-003 — Form weapon damage and flat imbues](#dru-003)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-60 forms and high-level weapon effects if low-level results imply scaling.
  - Observe / verify: Verify the actual level-60 base and any effect-specific exceptions before changing synthetic-weapon valuation.
- **High · [DRU-005 — Bear threat multipliers](#dru-005)**
  - Prerequisites: Lacerate from 42 and eventually level-60 ranks.
  - Observe / verify: Separate application and bleed threat at each stack; distinguish flat threat from damage multipliers.
- **High · [DRU-006 — Lacerate direct and periodic formula](#dru-006)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-42+ Bear, stable AP, no other bleeds, isolated first through fifth applications.
  - Observe / verify: Determine whether the first application deals direct damage and whether subsequent hits use the pre-existing or new stack count; separately measure tick damage and crits.
- **High · [DRU-011 — Proc enchants in animal forms](#dru-011)**
  - Prerequisites: Crusader access if unavailable in either beta cap.
  - Observe / verify: Repeat the form comparison with enough eligible attacks to distinguish no procs from a low rate. Move earlier if vendors or copied items make the enchant obtainable.
- **High · [DRU-012 — Bear outgoing and incoming rage formulas](#dru-012)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-60 Bear and known outgoing/incoming attacks.
  - Observe / verify: Check that the low-level formula still fits; test queued Maul separately because it replaces the ordinary white event.
- **High · [PAL-003 — Windfury Totem proc and charge rules](#pal-003)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-32+ Shaman providing Totem, Paladin recipient, no weapon imbue or other extra-attack source.
  - Observe / verify: Count eligible autos, specials and seal events; record AP aura charges and the next normal swing. Isolate avoided events and exclude immediate recursion before estimating chance.
- **High · [PRI-001 — Shadow Word: Death script value 150](#pri-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Death rank one at level 32; fixed SP, talents and target mitigation.
  - Observe / verify: Compare damage and backlash above/below execute thresholds, lethal/nonlethal hits and cooldown behavior. Subtract ordinary Early Demise and damage-range effects before attributing anything to 150.
- **High · [WAR-001 — Level-60 outgoing rage normalization](#war-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Level 60 and known one- and two-handed base speeds.
  - Observe / verify: Measure uncapped ordinary swings while varying damage independently; test the existing 4.5 and 4.5/1.3 rates rather than fitting a damage formula anew.
- **High · [WAR-002 — Off-hand and extra-swing rage](#war-002)**
  - Prerequisites: Relevant talent ranks and the actual raid Windfury buff.
  - Observe / verify: Repeat the off-hand ratio with the rage talent and test proc-generated swings, independently of damage and crit.
- **High · [WAR-006 — Flurry amount and charge events](#war-006)**
  - Prerequisites: Warrior with 2/5-5/5 Flurry (27-30 talent points, beyond the level-30 beta).
  - Observe / verify: Swing intervals with each rank to confirm 5% attack speed per rank.
- **High · [WAR-008 — Shield attacks and weapon procs](#war-008)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-40 Shield Slam and access to the exact proc source, including level-32+ Windfury Totem where relevant.
  - Observe / verify: Repeat isolated attacks, separating landed/avoided outcomes and weapon versus shield effects.
- **High · [WL-001 — Demonic Brand power source and threat](#wl-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Max-level pet ranks and relevant Tier effects.
  - Observe / verify: Verify the level extrapolation and Tier interactions rather than rediscovering the basic power owner.
- **High · [WL-009 — Demonic Knowledge ranked values](#wl-009)**
  - Prerequisites: Higher-level Warlock.
  - Observe / verify: Confirm how the bonus scales with player level.
- **Medium · [DATA-006 — Legacy item and enchant proc assumptions](#data-006)**
  - Prerequisites: Actual Crusader/Fiery enchants, fixed-speed weapons and separate white-only, special-attack and extra-swing samples. Move earlier only if the beta supplies these high-skill enchants.
  - Observe / verify: Estimate probability by eligible event type and weapon speed; record haste, handedness and form. A triggered spell's coefficient does not establish its PPM.
- **Medium · [DRU-010 — Feral stealth openers](#dru-010)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-32 Ravage and level-36 Pounce.
  - Observe / verify: Confirm opener damage and legal states against the implemented ranks.
- **Medium · [HUN-011 — Hunter’s Mark rank-value anomaly](#hun-011)**
  - Prerequisites: Access to ranks three and four with fixed ranged AP and no competing Mark.
  - Observe / verify: Compare target-conditioned ranged AP/damage and tooltip values per rank; record the client build.
- **Medium · [ROG-001 — Mutilate off-hand flat damage and Cold Blood](#rog-001)**
  - Prerequisites: Higher Mutilate ranks.
  - Observe / verify: Verify that the higher flat component follows the low-rank ordering; do not repeat already settled proc timing unless a patch changes it.
- **Medium · [WAR-010 — Weaponmaster hand-specific armor ignore](#war-010)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-60 armor-ignore combinations (items and debuffs not available in the beta).
  - Observe / verify: Confirm stacking with other armor-ignore effects.
- **Medium · [WL-002 — Incinerate's Immolate bonus scope](#wl-002)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-40 Incinerate and two known SP totals on the same target.
  - Observe / verify: Measure with/without Immolate at each SP total. Compare the slopes, not just one tooltip-range average; retain identical damage talents and mitigation.
- **Low · [ROG-004 — Deadly Poison V acquisition](#rog-004)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-60 Rogue and relevant trainer/vendor/content access if no source export resolves it first.
  - Observe / verify: Confirm acquisition without an unavailable raid book and record the obtainable rank.
- **Low · [SHA-011 — Totem of the Storm Maelstrom Weapon chance](#sha-011)**
  - Prerequisites: Level-60 Enhancement Shaman with Maelstrom Weapon and Totem of the Storm.
  - Observe / verify: Maelstrom Weapon stacks gained per Lightning Bolt over about 100 casts.

### Sources / code

Client data, source research, code inspection or simulator testing; no game experiment is required.

- **High · [CORE-011 — Base attributes and class conversions](#core-011)**
  - Prerequisites: An authoritative matching-build base-stat/conversion table, if obtainable.
  - Observe / verify: Compare exact level-60 rows and units to engine values; CombatRatings alone does not provide them.
- **High · [DATA-002 — Projected gear budget and stat prices](#data-002)**
  - Prerequisites: A proposed alternative budget or additional sourced crafted/PvP items.
  - Observe / verify: Fit out-of-sample items and compare total selected stat budgets by role; do not judge equivalence from the final DPS ranking.
- **High · [SCEN-001 — Tank boss damage and external healing](#scen-001)**
  - Prerequisites: A chosen workload or credible raid-log encounter specification.
  - Observe / verify: Change damage/healing assumptions as a separately labeled scenario and compare matched inputs, rather than silently redefining the tank benchmark.
- **High · [SCEN-003 — Tank target selection and threat coverage](#scen-003)**
  - Prerequisites: A three-target fixture with deliberately unequal per-target threat and debuff durations.
  - Observe / verify: Check selection, switching, maintenance and minimum target TPS; ensure current-target lookups do not accidentally read the first target's aura.
- **Medium · [CORE-009 — Eureka cast and periodic bonuses](#core-009)**
  - Prerequisites: Current engine, a Gnome DoT caster and a channel caster.
  - Observe / verify: Record tick damage with Eureka before application, after application, and on the last charge. Establish which effects the current wrapper actually preserves.
- **Medium · [DATA-006 — Legacy item and enchant proc assumptions](#data-006)**
  - Prerequisites: Crusader enchant 1900 → spell 20007; fixed proc events at levels 20 and 60.
  - Observe / verify: Check 100 Strength, the sourced self-heal range, health capping and damage/threat separation. Verify Lifestealing's heal separately if that enchant is enabled.
- **Medium · [DRU-010 — Feral stealth openers](#dru-010)**
  - Prerequisites: Current learned ranks/effects and an explicit precombat stealth state.
  - Observe / verify: Implement legal form/position/stealth gates, combo points and one-use opener behavior; ensure normal combat cannot repeat stealth attacks.
- **Medium · [SCEN-005 — General absorb-pool and shielding threat](#scen-005)**
  - Prerequisites: A shield with a sourced amount/duration and sequential controlled incoming hits.
  - Observe / verify: Verify partial and full consumption, expiry, overwrites and ordering without converting unconsumed capacity into effective healing.
- **Medium · [SHA-004 — Owned buff-totem effects and replacement](#sha-004)**
  - Prerequisites: Owned low/high-rank totems plus independent external providers.
  - Observe / verify: Check actual stats/resource returns, replacement, expiry and recall. Removing an owned provider must not delete a surviving external provider or leave its own effect permanent.
- **Low · [ROG-004 — Deadly Poison V acquisition](#rog-004)**
  - Prerequisites: Current trainer/vendor/recipe or loot-source export.
  - Observe / verify: Join the learned recipe to an obtainable source; distinguish the crafted poison item from its recipe.

## Evidence and implementation follow-up

The individual records identify source-ready corrections separately from assumptions. No item marked Implementation gap has been silently fixed by this research publication.

- **[DATA-010 — Raw haste rating conversion](#data-010)**: Represent raw haste rating separately from flat percentages, using the sourced level-60 conversion of 10 rating per percent.
- **[DATA-011 — Item-picker shared-crit EP](#data-011)**: Project shared equipment crit/hit into picker valuation exactly once, preserving explicitly scoped exceptions.
- **[DATA-008 — Unimplemented vendor item effects](#data-008)**: Implement Defender's Grip's ordinary outside-city 8% Block for 15 seconds; do not invent the other items' script behavior.

## Updating an answer

Edit `docs/uncertainties.json`, retaining the ID and qualified legacy references. Update the reviewed answer, confidence, remaining scope and concrete tests; distinguish an answered source question from outstanding implementation. Regenerate with `python3 tools/forever_bench/uncertainties.py`.

Old T50, T51 and T52 labels were reused for different topics. The qualified aliases below preserve those references without conflating their answers. Private chat and identifying logs stay local.

## Inventory coverage

- Read the legacy in-game checks, dispositions, demo checklist, all eleven class/shared/consumable beta-pass reports, mechanics/history/MythicSim/weekly/latest-upstream reviews and tank report. Screened the other top-level source, gear, race, Tier, haste, spell-inventory and patch reports for unresolved claims.
- Reviewed 137 spell-manifest records selected for assumed, unreviewed or uncertainty-bearing notes. A manifest label is provenance, not proof of an active bug: stale labels such as Bloodthrill's borrowed ID and Quick Strikes being absent are superseded by current code.
- Screened 267 matching runtime comment lines. Unknown-enum names, implementation-language assumptions and unrelated Classic/legacy encounter TODOs are not gameplay questions. Real-item proc/guardian notes remain source-indexed conditional work under DATA-006 and DATA-007.
- Generated historical build tables are not independent sources. Their current caveats are represented by class entries; old result counts, paid-hit conventions and unreplayed research are not relabeled as current evidence.
- Private chat and combat-log identifiers remain local. Public source links and the committed review conclusions provide the shareable evidence trail. This is consolidation and current-code reconciliation, not a fresh in-game verification of every mechanic.
- Complete October 8 overnight official post 5 / build 70291 bullet coverage is in docs/october-8-overnight-update.md. Supported implementations, already-correct paths, game-only changes, unregistered healing features and explicit provisional models are separated. Final1005 matrix scenarios and136 fresh tank selected/control workload rows are complete; actual publication is a separate deploy.yml/live verification receipt.

### CORE-001 — Boss attack tables

**Needs evidence · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Partly answered

**Question:** What are level-60 miss, dodge, parry, crit-suppression and glancing rules against level-63 targets?

**Finding:** An October 3 public measurement has 300 misses/4259 attacks against+3 targets at 1% hit:7.04%,95% Wilson about 6.31–7.85%. It supports an 8% rather than 9% single-weapon/special cap. This supersedes treating all suppression behavior as Classic-confirmed; ranged/dual-wield/boss-level scopes are not established by this sample. October 11 audit: Two sources agree that hit suppression is gone: the October 3 measurement (300 misses in 4,259 attacks at 1% hit against +3 targets, 7.04%, 95% CI 6.31–7.85%, excluding the 8% a suppressed table predicts) and magey/forever-warrior#1's completed checklist item 'Hit suppression is gone'. The same issue's October 10 sample (3,644 attacks) confirms crit-aura suppression (5.19% observed against 5.61% expected) and Classic miss 8%, dodge 6.5%, parry 14%, glancing 40% and block 5% rates against +3 targets. It also reports glancing damage reduction as currently broken in the beta (about 24.6% observed), so that number is not adopted.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Forever removes Classic hit suppression for melee and ranged weapon attacks: the 8% special miss against +3 targets falls with every point of hit. Crit-aura suppression (1.8% against +3) and Classic dodge, parry, block and glancing chances remain; glancing damage keeps the Classic formula while the beta's glancing penalty is acknowledged as broken.

**Impact:** All melee, ranged and tank comparisons; hit caps and crit value.

**Remaining scope:** Glancing damage once Blizzard fixes it; two-roll special crit; bonus weapon skill; level-63 confirmation.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Implemented: sim/core/target.go applies HitSuppression only outside Forever. Profiles selected for the old 9% cap are now 1% over the true 8% cap; gear re-selection is required to realise the gain.

**Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Known skill/hit, an equal-level and a +3-level target, recorded facing.
- Observe / verify: Count white/special/ranged outcomes separately; compare queued and unqueued attacks. This supplies a low-level table, not a level-63 certification.

**Beyond level 30 / launch**
- Prerequisites: Level-60 characters and level-63 targets on a build without the known glancing defect.
- Observe / verify: Repeat outcome and crit-suppression counts; compare damage of glances with ordinary hits at fixed AP.

**References:** [sim/core/attack.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/attack.go) · [sim/core/spell_result.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/spell_result.go) · [docs/check_dispositions.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/check_dispositions.md) · [https://github.com/magey/forever-warrior/issues/1](https://github.com/magey/forever-warrior/issues/1) · [docs/october-8-review.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/october-8-review.md)

**Earlier references:** T01 / T06

### CORE-002 — Energy regeneration and haste

**Needs evidence · High priority · Low confidence**

**Disposition:** Game test needed

**Question:** Does general haste increase Energy regeneration, and do attack-speed-only effects leave it unchanged?

**Finding:** PowerType establishes the base 10 Energy/sec, not the haste coefficient. The previously analyzed 1% sample spans both 10 and 10.1/sec within endpoint quantization error. No new controlled source in the reviewed issue collections settles the distinction.

**Current implementation / scenario:** 10 Energy/sec integrated in 100-ms steps; general haste provisionally increases the rate. Slice and Dice, Berserking and attack-only enchants do not. The step size is not a measured server tick.

**Impact:** Feral and all Rogue builds; haste and resource value.

**Remaining scope:** General-haste scaling, distinct from attack-speed effects.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Keep the existing haste multiplier explicitly provisional; do not import retail resource rules as a fact.

**Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Two known general-haste totals, identical resource talents, uncapped recovery windows and precise resource timestamps.
- Observe / verify: Repeat matched recovery cycles from low Energy to below the cap, with no attacks or refunds. Aggregate endpoint uncertainty; a single rounded 1% window is insufficient. Run an attack-speed-only control separately.

**References:** [docs/energy_audit.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/energy_audit.md) · [docs/check_dispositions.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/check_dispositions.md) · [sim/core/energy.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/energy.go) · [https://wago.tools/db2/PowerType?build=1.60.1.69977](https://wago.tools/db2/PowerType?build=1.60.1.69977)

### CORE-004 — Spell GCD versus physical GCD

**Model assumption · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** Which speed effects shorten magical and physical GCDs, and what is the minimum?

**Finding:** The consistently applied physical-school versus magical-school rule is a reasonable accepted working model, corroborated by the pinned WoWSims parser. The client gives category 133 and 1500 ms for both shocks and Mortal Strike, so those fields cannot independently prove which GCDs scale. This is not a remaining per-spell implementation hunt.

**Current implementation / scenario:** The adopted WoWSims-style rule hastes magical GCDs with casting speed, retains fixed physical GCDs, and uses a one-second floor. Missing magical schools were corrected across the audited utility spells.

**Impact:** All rotations; especially instant Shaman spells and physical 1.5-second abilities.

**Remaining scope:** An optional empirical check of the shared rule and one-second floor; not separate tests for every spell with the same classification.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Keep the adopted rule and its regression coverage. Preserve the distinction between damage school and melee/ranged hit table.

**Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Known casting-speed modifier, one magical instant and one physical 1.5-second action; client cooldown timestamps.
- Observe / verify: Compare GCD duration independently of cast time. Only test the floor when enough haste is actually available; a 1% modifier cannot establish it.

**References:** [docs/speed_audit.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/speed_audit.md) · [docs/weekly_review.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/weekly_review.md) · [sim/core/cast.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/cast.go) · [sim/core/spell.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/spell.go)

### CORE-007 — Judgement of Wisdom trigger rules

**Needs evidence · High priority · Low confidence**

**Disposition:** Game test needed

**Question:** Which events trigger Wisdom, at what probability and with what cooldown?

**Finding:** The mana amount is sourced: effect 698050 returns 59 at the highest rank. The proc probability is not settled by Wowhead's displayed 50%: all three captured SpellAuraOptions versions instead have 100% on the parent, which triggers dummy intermediate spell 1826. A server filter can exist behind that intermediate. Neither field proves the complete proc rule.

**Current implementation / scenario:** The level-60 return is 59 mana. The inherited event/proc model, including its 50% chance, remains provisional; self-hits are excluded.

**Impact:** Mana sustainability of melee Hunters, Paladins and other frequent attackers.

**Remaining scope:** Effective proc chance, avoided-white eligibility, periodic/proc eligibility and ICD.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Keep 50% explicitly provisional; do not replace it with 100% merely from the parent. The current code even allows avoided white swings, which needs its own event-category check.

**Beyond level 30 / launch**
- Prerequisites: A level-38+ Paladin with Seal/Judgement of Wisdom, uncapped mana recipients and isolated event sources.
- Observe / verify: Count mana returns per white hit, avoided white, special, direct spell, periodic tick and triggered effect. Compare event intervals to distinguish chance from ICD; the level-30 cap does not grant this seal.

**Needs evidence · High priority · Moderate confidence**

Those are distinct from Agility/Intellect conversion slopes and naked race/class base attributes. The latter are still inherited and are not established by the rating file or by low-level character examples. October 11 audit: PlayerExpectedStat (70338) confirms the level-60 conversions for all nine classes exactly: crit per Agility (Warrior 0.0500%, Paladin 0.0506%, Hunter 0.0189%, Rogue 0.0345%, Priest 0.0500%, Shaman 0.0508%, Mage 0.0514%, Warlock 0.0500%, Druid 0.0500%), spell crit per Intellect, base mana (e.g. Paladin 1512, Hunter 1720, Mage 1213) and 10 health per Stamina all match base_stats.go.

October 15 update: The October 15 notes and client (1259812-1259823, duration 15 s to 8 s) remove the charges, so the last-charge question no longer applies.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Eureka is an 8-second buff with no charges (client 1.60.1.70425): every eligible direct cast inside the window gets the cost and damage bonus. Ordinary periodic damage stays excluded; a channel started inside the window keeps the bonus on its ticks.

**Impact:** Gnome resource use and damage, particularly channels.

**Remaining scope:** Whether a channel started just before expiry keeps the bonus on later ticks.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Focused periodic-application, same-spell channel and nested-charge regressions pass. Do not relabel the old snapshot assumptions as current game verification.

### CORE-003 — Energy refunds on avoided attacks

**Accepted working answer · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** Which builders and finishers refund Energy on miss, dodge or parry, and what fraction of the paid cost returns?

**Finding:** The earlier review misread the client. Every player rank of Eviscerate (2098–31016), Rupture, Slice and Dice, Expose Armor, Rip (1079–9896) and Ferocious Bite (22568–31018) carries SPELL_ATTR1_DISCOUNT_POWER_ON_MISS (0x08000000) in 70009 and 70338. The ids without it are cost-free NPC or internal records with no skill line (1271520, 1271514, 1272982, 1289141, 1289142). In Era only builders carry the bit, and builders refund 80%; Forever extends the same attribute to finishers. Primal Bite, Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul and Lacerate have it; Swipe and the retained Mangle ids do not. October 11 audit: Rogue beta testers corroborate the finisher refund: 'parries or dodges refund cps and most energy' and 'energy refunds are in for everything' (Rogue Classic Discord, 2026-09-28/29). The same tester said misses do not refund, which differs from Classic's builder rule and from the engine (which refunds on any avoided outcome); that single statement is recorded, not adopted.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Forever finishers refund 80% of their paid Energy on a miss, dodge or parry, like builders: Eviscerate, Rupture, Expose Armor, Rip and Ferocious Bite. Combo points are spent only on a landed finisher.

**Impact:** Feral and Rogue resource supply, especially before hit cap or when attacking from the front.

**Remaining scope:** Whether a miss (as opposed to dodge/parry) refunds, and the exact fraction ('most').

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Implemented: Forever finishers use Refund 0.8 (eviscerate.go, rupture.go, expose_armor.go, rip.go, ferocious_bite.go).

**Optional / conditional · Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: A Rogue with builders/Eviscerate/Rupture, or a level-20 Cat with Claw/Rake/Rip; uncapped Energy and an avoidance-producing target.
- Observe / verify: Pair resource changes and combo points with each avoided action; subtract independently measured regeneration. Test builders and finishers separately.

**Optional / conditional · Beyond level 30 / launch**
- Prerequisites: Level-32+ Cat with Ferocious Bite.
- Observe / verify: Separate initial cost, excess-Energy spending, refund and combo-point retention on avoided Bites.

**References:** [docs/energy_audit.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/energy_audit.md) · [sim/core/energy.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/energy.go) · [sim/rogue/eviscerate.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/rogue/eviscerate.go) · [sim/druid/ferocious_bite.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/druid/ferocious_bite.go) · [https://wago.tools/db2/SpellMisc?build=1.60.1.70009](https://wago.tools/db2/SpellMisc?build=1.60.1.70009)

**Resolved · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Source-backed answer

This agrees with the Berserking/Arcane Missiles observation.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Channels are not hasted in Forever. The separate SpellHaste channel input has no current source and stays dormant.

**Impact:** Mage, Priest and Warlock channels; hypothetical haste scaling.

- Observe / verify: Identify its aura types before scheduling a gameplay test. Acquisition is not established merely by the hypothetical SpellHaste stat; move to launch only if the chosen source requires it.

### CORE-008 — Dynamic periodic damage boundaries

**Resolved · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Partly answered

**Question:** Which damage components update during an existing DoT, and which cast-specific bonuses remain attached?

**Finding:** The Forever Hunter wiki explicitly describes dynamic Sting RAP and periodic crit. Public reports also distinguish intended dynamic Thorns/Ret Aura scaling from their beta snapshot bug. These support the ordinary no-snapshot rule, but not every charged-cast or proc-payload exception.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Forever periodic damage uses dynamic stats/modifiers under the adopted no-snapshot model, with explicit cast-specific effects and Ignite exclusions. Deep Wounds also reads current weapon/AP state.

**Impact:** All DoT builds; temporary buffs, weapon swaps and poison upkeep.

**Remaining scope:** Narrow cast-specific exceptions belong to Eureka, Inner Focus and the individual proc records, not a blanket retest of every ordinary DoT.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Keep ordinary dynamic periodic damage as the reference rule. Do not multiply an already calculated Ignite/Deep Wounds payload again merely because ordinary DoTs are dynamic.

### CORE-014 — Mana restoration threat

**Outside current scenarios · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Outside current scenarios

**Question:** Which mana returns generate threat, who receives it, and is it divided between enemies?

**Finding:** Threat from mana gains is a negligible part of tank threat in the current scenarios. Moved outside current scenarios; it can be reopened if a scenario starts to depend on it.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Explicit NoThreat covers Forever Life Tap owner/demon, Dark Sacrifice, Shield Specialization and Improved Seal of Fury mana returns. Amounts/proc gates remain separately sourced; ordinary gains retain existing accounting.

**Impact:** Tank TPS and rotation comparisons: wasting mana can increase subsequent effective restoration and its credited threat without improving damage or survival.

**Remaining scope:** None for current scenarios.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** No change.

**Optional / conditional · Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: A mana user, effective mana potions, threat API readings and one versus several engaged enemies.
- Observe / verify: Measure total and per-enemy threat from one isolated return, including same-type and mixed-type packs. A mana-capped use is the wasted-resource control.

### CORE-016 — Common player Spirit regeneration

**Accepted working answer · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** Do all player classes share the Mage/Priest formula, including its intercept?

**Finding:** Both Hunter pairs and five of six Paladin pairs fit 6.25 + Spirit/8, apart from roughly 0.001 in API output. The first Paladin pair would fit at 48 rather than its reported 49 Spirit; this single outlier does not establish a different Paladin intercept. The API dump omitted effective-Spirit and casting-regeneration values. A common-player formula is a better-supported provisional model, not proof for all classes or level 60.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Forever players use the common working formula 6.25 + effective Spirit/8 MPS. Explicit class overrides, pets, Classic regeneration and the separate MP5 contribution remain unchanged.

**Impact:** Mana pacing, talents and gear for non-Mage/Priest mana users.

**Remaining scope:** Effective versus first-return UnitStat values, fractional stats, levels, MP 5/buff controls and coverage of other classes/pets.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Implemented the provisional common-player formula without an API-offset fudge. Focused checks cover the consistent measurements, casting/noncasting Spirit, both MP5 modes, preserved explicit overrides and unchanged pet/Classic formulas. Refresh affected mana pacing and comparisons; retain the unmatched raw sample.

**Optional / conditional · Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Hunter/Paladin plus another mana class, several Spirit values, no MP5/buffs, sufficient mana deficit.
- Observe / verify: Capture all UnitStat returns, GetManaRegen values, build/level/race and timed actual regeneration both inside/outside five-second rule.

**Optional / conditional · Beyond level 30 / launch**
- Prerequisites: Unresolved higher-level classes/passives.
- Observe / verify: Repeat only remaining level/class terms rather than assume low-level intercept is universal.

**References:** [docs/october-8-review.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/october-8-review.md) · [sim/core/mana.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/mana.go)

### CORE-019 — Talent modifier scope versus client class masks

**Resolved · High priority · High confidence**

**Disposition:** Source-backed answer

**Question:** Do simulated talents apply their damage, crit, hit and cost modifiers to the same spells as the client's class masks?

**Finding:** Differential audit, October 11: each benchmark build was constructed with and without every talent it takes (583 variants). The spells whose static modifiers changed were compared with the spells covered by the talent's client modifier masks (aura 107/108, ops damage, periodic, crit, crit damage, hit, cost, cast, cooldown and GCD). Defects found and fixed: Twin Disciplines applied to every instant Priest spell, including Mind Flay, Shadow Word: Death, Starshards and Penance, while the mask covers Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague and Holy Nova; a tester also found it does not affect Mind Flay. Holy Precision, Holy Specialization and Mental Agility applied to Penance (and Mental Agility to Shadow Word: Death), which their masks exclude. Mortal Shots applied to Sniper Shot, Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite and Wing Clip but not Serpent Sting; the mask is Auto/Aimed/Multi/Arcane/Serpent/Volley. Impale did not reach Rend's crits, which its mask includes. Investigated and correct: Elemental Fury on Searing/Magma totems (the mask includes their attack spells), Aftermath and Improved Seals (applied at cast or on the proc spell). Low-impact mismatches recorded but not changed: Genesis and Survival Tactics on AoE-only spells, Call of Flame on Fire Nova, Malediction's Soul Fire scope, and Paladin seal cost reductions (Paladins are never mana-limited in the benchmark).

**Current implementation / scenario:** Talent modifiers follow the client masks for every benchmark talent checked; exceptions are listed in the answer.

**Impact:** Shadow and Smite Priest, Marksmanship and Beast Mastery, and Warriors using Rend.

**Remaining scope:** Dynamic (aura-based) talent effects are outside a static differential check.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Fixed under Forever only; Classic behaviour unchanged.

**References:** [sim/priest/talents.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/priest/talents.go) · [sim/hunter/talents.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/hunter/talents.go) · [sim/hunter/serpent_sting.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/hunter/serpent_sting.go) · [sim/warrior/rend.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/warrior/rend.go)

### CORE-024 — Spell resistance against bosses

**Accepted working answer · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** How much of a magic hit does a level-63 boss resist, and what does Spell Piercing past zero do?

**Finding:** wowsims/forever #293/#350/#351/#436/#166 from Forever combat logs: no partial resists at 1-9 levels above the caster, 10% steps, K fitted to 9L at caster levels 20-30.

**Current implementation / scenario:** No level-based resistance. Average resist R / (|R| + 9 x caster level), R = target resistance (floored at 0) less Spell Piercing; partial resists in 10% steps; piercing past zero adds damage; DoT ticks use a tenth; no 1% spell miss floor.

**Impact:** Every caster gains about 6% against bosses; Arcane Subtlety and other piercing add a few percent.

**Remaining scope:** The constant above level 30 and the boss case at +3 levels.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Forever ruleset only; Classic keeps the old model.

**Optional / conditional · Beyond level 30 / launch**
- Prerequisites: Level-60 caster with known Spell Piercing on a level-63 target.
- Observe / verify: Share of hits in each 10% bucket over 1,000+ hits.

**References:** [sim/core/spell_resistances.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/spell_resistances.go) · [sim/core/spell_result.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/spell_result.go)

**Implementation / model follow-up:** The default MP5/5 rule remains appropriate for the intended model. The optional uniform fivefold setting is a hypothetical sensitivity mode, not a faithful emulation of the reported gear-only bug; its description should say so.

**Optional / conditional · Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Only if reproducing a particular live beta build is needed; gear with a known MP5 delta and a separate Wisdom/Mageblood control.

### CORE-026 — Melee swing after a cast

**Finding:** wowsims/forever #365; the vanilla rule, with SpellMisc Attributes[2] 0x20000 as the exception (Aimed Shot, Multi-Shot).

**Current implementation / scenario:** Yes, unless the spell is marked Do Not Reset Combat Timers or lets autos continue: explosives, Hammer of Wrath, Holy Wrath and Shaman bolts restart the swing at cast end.

**Impact:** Warriors and hunters with grenades, Retribution with Hammer of Wrath.

### CORE-033 — Ranks of one damage-over-time spell on a target

**Resolved · Medium priority · High confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** Do two ranks of the same caster damage-over-time spell stack on one target?

**Finding:** Answered by Jordan on 27 October: ranks do not stack.

**Current implementation / scenario:** No. Applying one rank removes any other rank of the same spell from that target. Channels are not affected.

**Impact:** Rotations cannot gain by alternating ranks of Corruption, Immolate, Shadow Word: Pain and similar spells.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Damage-independent base-speed Rage: 4.5 per weapon-second for two-handed, 4.5/1.3 for one-handed MH; outgoing white criticals now award twice normal Rage. Haste changes event frequency, not base speed.

### WAR-006 — Flurry amount and charge events

**Needs evidence · High priority · Low confidence**

**Disposition:** Game test needed

**Question:** Which events proc, refresh and spend Flurry, and does the talent curve or triggered aura determine speed?

**Finding:** The linked Flurry issue and current compendium chapter explicitly remain a model/testing plan. The active Warrior tree puts the first rank behind 25 points: level 35, with rank five at 39. Ordinary haste retaining rage per swing is supported elsewhere, but does not establish every Flurry charge rule. October 11 log audit: The public foreverlogs.gg reports contain no Warrior Flurry windows. They do show that Shaman Flurry, which has the same three client charges, ends on the first white swing after the crit that applied or refreshed it (SHA-009). Warrior Flurry may differ (the Shaman version also has a 500 ms consumption lockout), so the Warrior model keeps three charges until a Warrior is measured. Talent access: The level-30 beta gives 26 talent points, so a Warrior can take 25 Fury points (including Death Wish) and 1/5 Flurry now. The question matters: if Warrior Flurry lasts one white swing like Shaman Flurry (SHA-009), Fury and Fury (Sunder) lose about 7% and 2H Bloodthirst about 6% in the benchmark.

**Current implementation / scenario:** 5–25% melee speed; three shared charges. White-tagged events, including avoided swings and queued replacements, consume charges without a 500-ms gate. Melee crits refill after consumption. Each Cleave target may consume a charge.

**Impact:** All Flurry builds, especially dual wield and cleave.

**Remaining scope:** White/queued/extra-swing consumption, multi-target Cleave, refresh order and mid-swing timing.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Retain the current disclosed model; no source justifies changing charge logic in this research pass.

**Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Level-30 Warrior with 26 Fury points including Death Wish and 1/5 Flurry (for example Fury 25053005040010100, no Arms or Protection points); advanced combat logging.
- Observe / verify: Auto-attack a mob for three minutes with one weapon, then dual wielding, then with Heroic Strike queued every swing. Count white swings between each Flurry gain and fade, and note whether the buff icon shows 3 charges. About 60 Flurry procs per setup.

**Beyond level 30 / launch**
- Prerequisites: Warrior with 2/5-5/5 Flurry (27-30 talent points, beyond the level-30 beta).
- Observe / verify: Swing intervals with each rank to confirm 5% attack speed per rank.

**References:** [docs/flurry_review.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/flurry_review.md) · [sim/warrior/talents.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/warrior/talents.go) · [https://github.com/magey/forever-warrior/issues/12](https://github.com/magey/forever-warrior/issues/12) · [https://ppach-warriorcompendium.share.connect.posit.cloud/flurry.html](https://ppach-warriorcompendium.share.connect.posit.cloud/flurry.html) · [ui/core/talents/trees/warrior.json](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/ui/core/talents/trees/warrior.json) · [https://foreverlogs.gg/](https://foreverlogs.gg/)

<a id="war-003"></a>

### WAR-003 — Incoming rage and mitigation

**Accepted working answer · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** Does unmitigated damage × 10 / maximum health explain incoming rage at all armor/health values?

**Finding:** wowsims/forever #356 measured k = rage x c / pre-mitigation damage on Forever logs: 1.99 (attackers 16-42), 1.75 (44), 1.61 (46), 1.55 (50-60); the build notes describe the same 20-40% armor range.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Rage from damage taken = 2.5 x (1 - A) x pre-mitigation damage / c(attacker level), c(L) = 0.0091107836 L^2 + 3.225598133 L + 4.2652911; A = 20% up to attacker level 42, 30% at 44, 36% at 46, 38% at 50, 40% at 63, interpolated. Crits and crushing blows count, armor/blocks/absorbs do not. Any manual override returns the older coefficient-10 formula.

**Impact:** Protection rotation, self-damage resource gains and tank stat trade-offs.

**Remaining scope:** The 63 row (40%) is not measured; at 60 the curve sits 2.4% below the logs.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Engine (sim/core/forever_incoming_rage.go) and the planner's rage forecast (sim/planner) use it.

**Optional / conditional · Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Level 30 Warrior and Bear, fractional Rage trace, no outgoing autos/spending/passive gains; independent Armor/Stamina and known enemy levels.
- Observe / verify: Compare unabsorbed, partially/fully shielded ordinary/crit/crush hits; vary attacker level to identify the health lookup. A one-level fit establishes only an effective coefficient.

**Optional / conditional · Beyond level 30 / launch**
- Prerequisites: Level 60 and known incoming attacks, only when higher-level access exists.
- Observe / verify: Validate extrapolation separately; do not treat client level 60 baselines as a live measurement.

**Optional / conditional · Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Level-30 Warrior/Bear, DoT-only attacker then separated channeled bolts; no outgoing autos, Bloodrage, Berserker Rage or other on-hit/resource bonuses. Preserve uncapped, unmodified fractional power tracing.
- Observe / verify: Log actual damage, absorbed amounts and event types. Accumulate enough ticks for fractional Rage to be observable; compare isolated DoT/channeled delivery with a direct-hit control. Do not infer periodic eligibility from a rounded zero or mixed-resource combat.

<a id="war-019"></a>

### WAR-019 — Slam swing timer and Improved Slam cooldown

**Resolved · High priority · High confidence**

**Disposition:** Source-backed answer

**Question:** Does untalented Forever Slam interrupt melee swings, and how much cooldown does Improved Slam remove?

**Finding:** The 'Panel' rule that Slam no longer resets the swing timer is not what the client ships. Untalented ranks (1240193, 1464, 8820, 11604, 11605) keep InterruptFlags 15 (including Combat) and lack SPELL_ATTR2_DO_NOT_RESET_COMBAT_TIMERS, like Era's Slam. Improved Slam (12862) overrides every rank (aura 332) with 1310196–1310200, which have InterruptFlags 7 and set DO_NOT_RESET_COMBAT_TIMERS; its text says 'In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing'. Its cooldown modifier is −3000 ms at both ranks (curve [0.25, 3], [0.5, 3]); the engine had 1.5 s per point.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Untalented Slam: no autos during the cast; both swings restart from its completion. Improved Slam: autos continue and no reset. 18-second cooldown, 15 seconds with either rank of Improved Slam.

**Impact:** All Warrior DPS rotations that cast Slam; the Fury and Arms benchmark rotations.

**Remaining scope:** None.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Implemented in slam.go with a cast-speed-correct reset; regression TestForeverSlamSwingTimerDependsOnImprovedSlam. The benchmark Warrior rotations still cast Slam at 30 (15 for Arms) Rage; with the corrected engine, Fury and Fury (Sunder) gain 4.5%/4.3% without Slam, and Arms/2H Bloodthirst 2.0%/0.7% with a 50-Rage gate.

**References:** [sim/warrior/slam.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/warrior/slam.go) · [docs/forever_rules.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/forever_rules.md) · [docs/auto_attack_audit.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/auto_attack_audit.md) · [https://wago.tools/db2/SpellMisc/csv?build=1.60.1.70338](https://wago.tools/db2/SpellMisc/csv?build=1.60.1.70338) · [https://wago.tools/db2/SpellInterrupts/csv?build=1.60.1.70338](https://wago.tools/db2/SpellInterrupts/csv?build=1.60.1.70338)

**Finding:** The class deep dive: 'Rend: Now gains significant damage scaling from Attack Power'; 'Thunder Clap: Now gains significant damage scaling from Attack Power ... Fight Club measurements: Rend 0.02 AP per tick at rank 2 using current AP, with Improved Rend scaling the AP term; Thunder Clap about 0.068–0.07 AP, threat equal to damage.

**Impact:** Arms (Rend upkeep) and Protection Warrior threat; multi-target Thunder Clap damage.

**Remaining scope:** Max-rank coefficients.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Implemented (Forever only). Arms moves from −5.6% to −2.9% overall after the Slam correction.

**Optional / conditional · Beyond level 30 / launch**

- Observe / verify: Repeat the comparison for the top ranks.

### WAR-021 — Revenge Attack Power scaling and threat

**Accepted working answer · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** What is Revenge's AP coefficient and threat formula in Forever?

**Finding:** A six-point fit at rank 2 in the published 'Warrior Threat Values' sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vQxd44ah_iUJNcTdH2mpI9nTMNbQEGV9COXkD1nRHi6NGxiU-TvdtkIJBik7KkgN6gKCs7Sn2E-LVxU/pubhtml): threat = 1.495 x 2.25 x (damage roll + 0.28 AP), residuals under 0.5 threat, with no flat component. A separate tester measured 0.20 AP at rank 1 (level 20, 130–252 AP, weapon-independent). The engine previously had no AP term and a Classic-style 2.25 x 2 x level flat bonus.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Revenge damage = rank roll + 0.28 AP (x Improved Revenge); threat = 2.25 x damage with no flat bonus.

**Impact:** Protection Warrior damage and threat; the largest single change in this audit (Protection DPS +34% at level 60).

**Remaining scope:** The rank-6 coefficient: the two low-rank measurements differ (0.20, 0.28), so the level-60 value may be higher or lower. Treat Protection results as sensitive to this value.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Implemented with 0.28 for rank 6 (Forever only).

**Optional / conditional · Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Level-30 Warrior (Revenge rank 2), two gear sets differing only in Attack Power.
- Observe / verify: Revenge non-crit damage and threat; about 50 casts per set.

**Optional / conditional · Beyond level 30 / launch**
- Prerequisites: Level-60 Warrior (Revenge rank 6).
- Observe / verify: Repeat to replace the extrapolated 0.28 AP coefficient.

Scoped three-target, miss, zero/manual override and Classic-retention checks validate the exposed model, not its server coefficients. October 11 audit: The client now carries an explicit threat effect (SpellEffect 63) on every Demoralizing Shout rank: 11/19/27/35/43, so rank 5 is 43, matching the retained 43.2 convention. A published Fight Club threat sheet measured rank 2 at about 22.7 per target before modifiers on a level-30 character, slightly above the client's 19, suggesting mild level growth.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Nonzero affected-target behavior is implemented. Maximum-rank defaults are 43.2 Shout and 100 Roar, before stance/global multipliers, as Classic-derived conventions. Player optional override preserves explicit zero; Classic ignores it.

**Impact:** Warrior/Bear multi-target threat and cost-constrained maintenance.

**Remaining scope:** Actual per-rank flat threat and any hidden target/distribution behavior beyond the tested model.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Record defaults/override with comparisons; do not call 43.2/100 measured values or restore the former zero as intended behavior.

**Optional / conditional · Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Level-30 Warrior or Bear with learned Shout/Roar, one and multiple controlled enemies, threat API and no other damage/resource gains.
- Observe / verify: Measure each landed target and miss boundary separately; remove stance/global modifiers before estimating flat threat.

### WAR-023 — Benchmark Warrior rotations after the Slam and Rend corrections

**Resolved · Medium priority · High confidence**

**Disposition:** Source-backed answer

**Question:** Which Slam and Rend usage is best for each Warrior benchmark row on the corrected engine?

**Finding:** Screened Slam at no use and 30–70 Rage, with and without Rend, on every race (seed 20261012), then confirmed on an independent seed (20261099): Fury +5.31% (every race +5.15% or more), Fury (Sunder) +4.98%, Arms +1.93%, 2H Bloodthirst +0.90% (every race positive). Dual-wield Slam loses at every threshold under the swing reset; Fury rows had Improved Rend talented without casting Rend, which now scales with AP. The non-benchmark AoE and Spearing dual-wield presets also drop Slam.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Fury and Fury (Sunder): no Slam; Rend maintained after Whirlwind. Arms: Slam at 50+ Rage. 2H Bloodthirst: Slam at 50+ Rage and Rend after Whirlwind.

**Impact:** All four Warrior DPS rows.

**Remaining scope:** None.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Presets and the 40 ranked profiles updated.

### WAR-028 — Fury rotation rules learned by reinforcement learning

**Accepted working answer · Medium priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** Which choices does the Fury rotation miss?

**Finding:** A policy network that chose every action in the engine beat the published rotation; its differences, written as APL rules and confirmed on 4,096 paired fights each, give these gains. The network itself stays about 6 DPS ahead.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Fury: Overpower dance up to 35 rage, also in execute and during Recklessness; Rend refreshed in Battle Stance outside execute; Heroic Strike from 40 rage; Hamstring only with the next main-hand swing at least 1 s away; Demonic Rune at up to 60 rage. Fury (Sunder) the same without the Rend refresh. 2H Bloodthirst: dance up to 60 rage, Heroic Strike from 80. Fury and Fury (Sunder) talents 19/31/1 (Improved Heroic Strike 3/3 and Improved Bloodrage 1/2 instead of two Enrage points).

**Impact:** Fury +23 (rotation +22, talents +1.5), Fury (Sunder) +19, 2H Bloodthirst +36 DPS on paired fights.

**Remaining scope:** Depends on the provisional Warrior rage model, stance-swap rage retention and WAR-029; the network's finer swing timing is not captured.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** APLs and the Fury talent preset.

**Optional / conditional · Beyond level 30 / launch**
- Prerequisites: Level-60 Fury Warrior.
- Observe / verify: Overpower casts and damage in the execute phase with and without the dance.

### PAL-011 — Redoubt proc curve

**Resolved · Medium priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Source-backed answer

**Question:** Does Redoubt proc at 2/4/6/8/10% by rank?

**Finding:** Public foreverlogs.gg reports for six Protection Paladins show Redoubt on 10.0% of isolated landed melee attacks (1,404 of 14,094) and 9.8% of isolated missed, dodged or parried attacks (274 of 2,794), counting only attacks with no other attack within 300 ms. This matches 10% at 5/5 and shows that avoided attacks also roll.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Any melee attack against the Paladin, landed or avoided, has a 2% chance per rank to grant the Redoubt block bonus (4% block per rank, 10 seconds or 5 blocks).

**Impact:** Protection block uptime and defensive talent value.

**Remaining scope:** Proc chance at lower ranks (talent ranks are not in the logs).

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Implemented: avoided attacks now roll in Forever (sim/paladin/talents.go).

### DRU-006 — Lacerate direct and periodic formula

**Needs evidence · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Partly answered

**Question:** Are the stack-dependent weapon term and bleed base the correct Forever damage formula?

**Finding:** The parent rows source 10/12/15 bleed damage per three-second tick, five stacks and a 10% weapon-damage term. The uncertainty is narrower than the whole formula: the description says 'per existing application', whereas the engine uses the resulting stack including the new application. Child 414647 has a separate 20% weapon effect and is not proof of its current script use.

**Current implementation / scenario:** 10% form weapon damage per resulting stack and level-dependent bleed base per stack; inherited interpretations remain unvalidated.

**Impact:** Bear rotation and damage, distinct from its threat multiplier.

**Remaining scope:** Pre- versus post-application stack count, exact child dispatch and any hidden AP/script term.

### DRU-017 — Rake Attack Power scaling

**Needs evidence · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** How much Attack Power does Rake's hit and bleed gain?

**Finding:** The September 30 class deep dive says Rake now gains increased damage from Attack Power. The 1.60.1.70425 client carries no coefficient (the term is server-side, as with Swipe's 3%). Fitted to public beta logs from October 2-10 (1,115 rank-1 Rake events): bleed ticks of three Cats with known gear (Cat AP about 250, 330-370 and 465) are 24-28, 36 and 42 against a base of 16 with Savage Fury and Rend and Tear, giving 4-5% per tick; the hit, after armor, fits about 1.45 times the tick coefficient, as the base values do (23 against 16).

**Current implementation / scenario:** Hit +6.5% of Attack Power and each of the three ticks +4.5%, snapshotted on application. With it, Feral keeps Rake up (+6.1%); at two thirds of these values the gain is still +3.1%, and without the term Rake loses 2.9%.

**Impact:** Feral rotation and talents.

**Remaining scope:** A direct measurement at two Attack Power values.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Forever-only Attack Power terms on the Rake hit and bleed.

**Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: A level-30 Cat with Rake; a way to change Attack Power by a known amount (Battle Shout, a Blessing of Might or an AP item).
- Observe / verify: Rake tick damage (non-crit) with and without the Attack Power change, on a target without bleed modifiers.

### DRU-018 — On-hit effects at the Cat and Bear form attack speed

**Needs evidence · Medium priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** Do proc-per-minute effects on special attacks in Cat Form use the form's 1.0 attack speed or the equipped weapon's speed?

**Finding:** Druid testers confirmed on September 26 that weapon chance-on-hit effects proc in Cat Form; an October 8 question about whether 1.0 speed raises the proc rate of slow weapons went unanswered. Public beta logs (October 2-10) show Flametongue Totem damage on Cat hits at the 1.0 speed: a Wind Spirit Staff (3.3) Druid's Flametongue Attack hits for 18-19 in caster form and 5-6 in Cat Form, and a Manual Crowd Pummeler (2.0) Cat's 642 non-crit Flametongue Attacks are 9-11 with none near the 2.0-speed value, including those from special attacks. No log carries a Cat PPM proc, so the PPM rule is inferred from that. Before this change, 15 proc-trigger effects used the weapon speed on special attacks while Crusader, Fiery Weapon and the 53 weapon-proc helpers used 1.0.

**Current implementation / scenario:** In Forever the form attack is the equipped weapon's damage per second at the form's speed (Cat 1.0, Bear 2.5). White and special hits both roll PPM effects at the form speed, and speed-scaled on-hit damage uses it too. Classic keeps its tested rule (special attacks use the equipped weapon's speed).

**Impact:** Feral and Bear with chance-on-hit weapons or proc enchants (not the modeled ranking gear, which has no proc effects).

**Remaining scope:** Measured PPM proc counts per Cat special attack with a slow weapon.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Forever PPM rolls use the form speed for every path.

**Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: A Cat with a slow (3.0+ speed) weapon carrying a PPM effect, such as Crusader, Fiery Weapon or a chance-on-hit weapon.
- Observe / verify: Procs per landed white hit and per landed Shred or Claw over a few hundred of each; compare with PPM x 1.0 / 60 and PPM x weapon speed / 60.

**References:** [sim/core/aura_helpers.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/aura_helpers.go) · [sim/core/flametongue_totem.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/flametongue_totem.go) · [sim/druid/forms.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/druid/forms.go)

### DRU-001 — Omen of Clarity proc frequency

**Accepted working answer · High priority · Moderate confidence**

**Disposition:** Credible working answer

**Question:** Is the client's 100% field a literal proc guarantee after the ten-second ICD?

**Finding:** Public foreverlogs.gg reports (691 Druid proc windows: Cat, Bear and caster) confirm the 10-second cooldown and show that the client's 100% is not literal. A two-rate fit after the cooldown gives white hits 5.5-7.5% in Cat Form (1.0-second attacks) and 14.5-18.5% in Bear Form (2.5-second attacks), the same 3.5-4.5 procs per minute, and abilities, spells and heals 18-23% per cast (the ranges are fits with and without windows whose trigger was not identified). This agrees with community reports of 'about 20%'.

**Current implementation / scenario:** After the 10-second cooldown, a landed white melee hit grants Clearcasting at 4 procs per minute of attack speed (6.7% in Cat Form, 16.7% in Bear Form), and a landed ability, spell or heal has a 20% chance.

**Impact:** Feral and Balance resources, and Bear choices where eligible.

**Remaining scope:** Balance-only samples were small; whether multi-target hits roll once per target.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** Implemented: after the 10-second cooldown, white hits at 4 procs per minute and other eligible events at 20% (sim/druid/omen_of_clarity.go).

**Optional / conditional · Current beta · level 30**
- Prerequisites: Level-20+ Druid in Cat Form, then in caster form, with no other Clearcasting source.
- Observe / verify: After each proc, count landed white hits and landed abilities or spells separately, from the end of the 10-second cooldown to the next proc. About 60 procs per form.

### DRU-015 — Furor through Bear Form

**Resolved · Low priority · High confidence**

**Disposition:** Source-backed answer

**Question:** Does Furor keep Cat Energy through Bear Form?

**Finding:** Notes and the new Furor 17056 text; Bear and Dire Bear gain a -100% Energy regeneration aura. Howling Idol's Shifting Power reduction is 0.5 s (1291059). October 16 follow-up: With Furor keeping Cat Energy through Bear Form, bear-weaving was screened (Enrage plus Primal Bite or Lacerate, energy, cooldown and mana gates, with Mangle, Natural Shapeshifter, Enraged Idol and Idol of the Ursine Twins). Every variant lost (the best weaves 0.4-2.8%, frequent weaving 22-33%): each weave pays two shapeshifts (55% of base mana each) that would otherwise fund Shifting Power, and Energy does not regenerate in Bear Form.

**Current implementation / scenario:** Shifting into Cat restores 20% per point of the Energy last held in Cat plus 2 per point per second spent outside Bear, up to 20 per point; the saved Energy survives Bear Form and Bear time earns nothing.

**Impact:** Feral (bear-weaving only).

**Remaining scope:** None.

**Implementation / model follow-up:** sim/druid/forms.go, sim/druid/items.go.

**References:** [https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/wow-forever-beta-development-notes-%E2%80%93-updated-october-15/2360696/6](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/wow-forever-beta-development-notes-%E2%80%93-updated-october-15/2360696/6) · [https://wago.tools/builds-diff?to=1.60.1.70425&from=1.60.1.70374](https://wago.tools/builds-diff?to=1.60.1.70425&from=1.60.1.70374) · [docs/october-15-update.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/october-15-update.md)
